content.short: Halborn provides blockchain security services, including advisory, penetration testing, and audits.
content.description: Halborn delivers blockchain security solutions, including security advisory, advanced penetration testing, smart contract audits, and DevOps automation services; founded in 2019 by Steven Walbroehl and Rob Behnke, the company has grown to a team of over 100 security engineers, including specialists in offensive security, dedicated to delivering thorough protection for blockchain projects and systems across ecosystems.
content.meta: Halborn offers blockchain security services, including advisory, penetration testing, and audits. Discover Halborn and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Bank Frick Strengthens $1B Crypto Custody
resources.tldr: An audit of a bank's key ceremony, which is the moment custody is either done properly or quietly compromised for years. Rare visibility into that process.

resources.title: Hardening Critical CBDC Pilot Infrastructure
resources.tldr: Risks found across validator nodes and APIs during a central bank digital currency pilot. Useful for seeing how a state-run chain differs in threat model.

resources.title: Securing Privacy-Preserving Infrastructure for Institutional Adoption
resources.tldr: Reviewing a chain built so institutions can transact without publishing positions. The privacy requirement changes what an auditor looks for.
